correctness.rationale: For nonempty triangle-free H, all triangle-avoiding faces in K_s∨H are precisely arbitrary H-side subsets, a single central vertex together with an independent H-set, or two central vertices with no H-vertex. Thus X=A∪K_s^(1)∪∪(c_i*Ind(H)) with A=full simplex on H. Collapsing nonempty contractible A via a CW cofibration and then a star tree of edges c_i to a chosen base vertex yields s unreduced suspensions and binomial(s,2) central loops, including disconnected Ind(H). This argument is valid integrally and all s≥2. Simple sanity case H=K2,s=2 yields K4 triangle-free-subset 1-skeleton ~ wedge of 3 circles, matching one central loop plus two suspensions of S0. Independent checker reconstructs finite homology only and is not an all-graph proof.
